title: People’s Mañanera September 3
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity’s Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available[here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Governing With Dialogue, Not Repression  
** Mexico maintains governability through dialogue, civil liberties, and
peaceful conflict resolution. President Claudia Sheinbaum emphasized “that
work that goes unnoticed speaks to how well we’re doing, because we’re
safeguarding the country’s governability.”

**Opportunities to Keep Young People Away from Violence  
** The “Addressing the Root Causes” initiative brings education, jobs,
culture, and community engagement to priority municipalities, keeping young
people away from addiction and criminal groups. Peace is built by offering
alternatives for life.

**Peace Is Built by Addressing the Root Causes  
** With 545,000 door-to-door visits, Peace Fairs, and 8.5 million services
provided, the 4T brings well-being to communities. Nearly 14,000 weapons were
voluntarily surrendered, while victims and their families receive support with
truth, justice, and reparations.

**Search Until Found: A Priority for the State  
** The National Search Strategy prioritizes the search for missing persons
while they are still alive and provides support to their families. More than
13,000 missing persons have already been located, 1,600 criminal recruitment
profiles have been deactivated, and more than 400 specialists are
strengthening search efforts.

**Mexico Embraces and Defends Its Citizens  
** Through the “Mexico Embraces You” program, 1.6 million services have been
provided to repatriated citizens. In relation to U.S. government deportations
of undocumented immigrants to third countries, the President was emphatic,
declaring that “there is no reason to send our citizens to Central America.”

**The People Have the Final Say  
** Sheinbaum noted that “99% of the commentators share the same opinion,” but
that narrative contrasts with what the people are saying, as reflected in the
68–70% presidential approval rating. This gap is also reflected in the legacy
of the transformation movement. “AMLO is in the hearts of the people, and
that’s not going to change,” she explained.
